rice.description: Staple cereal; thrives in standing water and clay/loamy soils.

maize.description: Versatile cereal used for food, feed and industry.

kidneybeans.description: Protein-rich legume, prefers cooler growing conditions.

mothbeans.description: Highly drought-tolerant pulse suited to arid/sandy soils.

mungbean.description: Short-duration pulse, good for crop rotation.

blackgram.description: Widely used pulse; fixes atmospheric nitrogen.

lentil.description: Cool-season pulse, tolerant of light irrigation.

pomegranate.description: Drought-hardy fruit tree, good for semi-arid regions.

banana.description: Heavy water and nutrient user; year-round harvesting possible.

mango.description: Long-lived fruit tree; needs a distinct dry spell to flower well.

grapes.description: Needs well-drained soil and controlled irrigation for quality fruit.

watermelon.description: Warm-season vine crop, sandy loam preferred.

muskmelon.description: Warm-season vine crop, sensitive to waterlogging.

apple.description: Needs a cold winter chill period; suited to hill regions.

orange.description: Citrus tree; sensitive to waterlogging, prefers well-drained soil.

papaya.description: Fast-growing fruit tree, sensitive to frost and waterlogging.

coconut.description: Coastal/tropical palm, needs consistent moisture and warmth.

cotton.description: Major fibre cash crop, needs a long frost-free period.

jute.description: Fibre crop needing high humidity and standing water at times.

coffee.description: Shade-grown perennial; needs consistent rainfall and mild temperatures.
